resources.string: Block Ads. Protect Privacy. Take Control.
Persistent status notification while AdZero local VPN DNS protection is running.
Optionally detects and activates the Skip Ad button inside YouTube when skippable ads appear. Processes only YouTube skip-button UI elements locally and never reads or uploads unrelated content.
AdZero runs 100% locally on your device. No account registration, no ad or analytics SDKs, no remote VPN servers, and no external upload of DNS logs or notification previews.
